svg.title: Incremental compilation over a persistent semantic store
svg.desc: Changed project files and dependency Loaves are diffed into seeds that enter a ranked record graph, arranged as namespaces in import order by phase, where only changed records are recomputed in one sweep with early cutoff and frozen Loaf facts are read but never recomputed. The graph and rustc fill a home-wide store of content-named facts, each missing fact exactly once; Oven only asks that store, Loaves arrive with their facts already filled, and the store serves the LSP, MCP and graph readers and compacts into the published Loaf.
svg.text: RECORD GRAPH · RANKED DAG · ONE SWEEP · EARLY CUTOFF
Rows are namespaces in import order. Reads point only up or left, so the graph stays acyclic.
Loaf rows are frozen: reads pass into them, but nothing inside a Loaf is ever recomputed.
Cold and warm take one path: Oven asks the bakery for every fact.
A miss is filled once, by one producer; every later ask finds it.
Loaves arrive with their facts filled, so cold builds compile only what is new.
